caption: •General Solo (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. During battle, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt from your Reserve Deck (then place that card out of play). Once per turn, may ▲ a non-Interrupt card with “door” in game text.
lore: *Scout*. *Leader* of the Rebel strike team on Endor. Needed the cleverness of a Corellian to destroy the Endor control bunker. Discovered the truth about Luke and Leia.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); slip deploy 4 / forfeit 8 (printed card 6 / 8). Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior. Rebel. Game text opens with the yellow Rebel pilot icon + '3.' → {pilot:3}. The slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Lore wording matches the wiki; bold taken from the 745 px PC remake V0-L-generalsolo.gif, which prints *Scout* and *Leader* in bold (not discernible on the 350 px Endor scan). Base scan only 350 px; copyright Endor 1999. Modern: V0-L-generalsolo.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 0 remake); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
